PRESIDENT
OF
UNION OF RUSSIAN
ARMY AND NAVY MEN
June 27th 192...
№ 255
Шанхай.—Shanghai.

CONFIDENTIAL.
To Captain R. V. MARTIN,
Act. Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police Force.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. ...8/...
Date ...29...

Dear Sir,

Informations have reached us that Mr. Anatole ARSHIN, a former non-commissioned officer and a member of the Union of Russian Army & Navy Men, is in contact with some bolsheviks being a secret agent of the U.S.S.R. Government.

This ARSHIN has served until now as watchman at the Palace Hotel, but owing to the above rumours among other watchmen of the Hotel had to be discharged and replaced by another man.

If these accusations are correct such a person naturally cannot remain member of our Union.

Therefore we would like to verify the above, and expecting that the Shanghai Municipal Police Force might possess informations of the non-reliability of this Anatole ARSHIN, I have the honour to request you to provide me with anything you would find possible to give concerning that man which would throw light on his connections with the bolsheviks.

Submitting my excuse for the trouble rendered and thanking you in advance,

I am, dear Sir,

Yours very respectfully
C. P. Wall
Lieutenant-General,
PRESIDENT of the UNION

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
I. O. D. 编号 ...8/...
日期 ...29...

尊敬的先生：

我方获悉，Anatole ARSHIN 先生，前士官及俄罗斯陆海军退役军人联合会会员，正与一些布尔什维克接触，系苏联政府的秘密特工。

此 ARSHin 此前一直担任礼查饭店（Palace Hotel）的看守员，但由于上述传闻在饭店其他看守员中流传，不得不将其解雇并由他人接替。

如果这些指控属实，这样的人自然不能继续保留在我会会员资格。

因此，我们希望核实上述情况，并鉴于上海公共租界工部局警务处可能掌握有关此 Anatole ARSHIN 不可靠的情报，谨请阁下提供您认为可行的、有助于澄清其与布尔什维克联系的任何信息。

对由此带来的麻烦表示歉意，并预先致谢，

尊敬的先生，

您非常恭敬的
C. P. Wall
中将，
联合会主席

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. I. D. REGISTRY CENTRAL FILING SYSTEM No. I. O. D. ... Date.. April ..22, ..1929）

Subject (in full) A. F. Alshin - Communist.

Made by P.C.S. Maklaevsky Forwarded by J. Rubinstein, C.D.I.

Information has been received to the effect that
a Russian named A.F.Alshin, who is employed as a watchman
at the Palace Hotel, is an old member of the Russian Communist
Party, a member of the G.P.U. and an agent-provocateur.
During the civil war in Siberia in 1919 he was a
member of the G.P.U. at "Zima" Railway Station on the Great
Siberian Railway near Irkutsk. From 1920 and 1923 he was
a member of the G.P.U. in Chita, Transbaikal Province. In the
latter year he went to Harbin and was employed for some time
in Harbin Chinese Police. In 1926 he left Harbin for Shanghai
and in January 1927 joined the Russian Unit of the S.V.C., with
which he served until June 1927, when he was disbanded. In
September of the same year he rejoined the Russian Unit of the
S.V.C. serving until November 1927. Shortly afterwards he
obtained employment as a clerk in the office of the Committee
for the Defence and Protection of Russian Rights and Interests
at 872 Avenue Joffre, which position he held until June 1928.
In September 1928 he entered his present employment.
On April 1929, while under the influence of liquor
and in company of 4 other watchmen, he openly confessed himself
to be a Communist and a member of the G.P.U. He is said to be
in close touch with a Russian woman named A.A. Novikova, who
is reported to be a Soviet Courier and who arrived here from
Vladivostock in January 1929 and left in February 1929.

B. Maklaevsky
P. C. S.

A/D.C.I.

Copies to H.B.M.Consul, Lt. Col.Halland,Capt.Shelley,Lt.Carlson.
Sent. 22.4.
L.Y.Z.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处登记室 中央归档系统 I. O. D. 编号 ... 日期.. 1929年4月 ..22日）

事由（全称） A. F. Alshin - 共产党员。

由 P.C.S. Maklaevsky 制作 由 J. Rubinstein, 刑事侦缉督察转发。

收到情报称，一名受雇于礼查饭店（Palace Hotel）担任看守员的俄国人 A.F.Alshin，是俄国共产党的老党员，国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）成员，且为挑衅特工。
在1919年西伯利亚内战期间，他是位于伊尔库茨克附近西伯利亚大铁路“济马”（Zima）火车站的国家政治保卫局成员。从1920年至1923年，他是外贝加尔省赤塔市国家政治保卫局的成员。同年他前往哈尔滨，并在哈尔滨中国警察部门任职一段时间。1926年他离开哈尔滨前往上海，并于1927年1月加入上海义勇队（S.V.C.）俄国分队，服役至1927年6月该分队解散。同年9月，他重新加入上海义勇队俄国分队，服役至1927年11月。不久之后，他在霞飞路872号俄罗斯权利与利益保护委员会办公室获得一份职员工作，该职位他一直担任至1928年6月。1928年9月，他进入目前的职位。
1929年4月，他在饮酒后并与另外4名看守员在一起时，公开承认自己是共产党员和国家政治保卫局成员。据说他与一名名为 A.A. Novikova 的俄国妇女保持密切联系，据报道该女子是苏联信使，于1929年1月从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达此地，并于1929年2月离开。

B. Maklaevsky
警长

A/副刑事侦缉督察。

副本送：英国驻华领事、Halland 中校、Shelley 上尉、Carlson 中尉。
发送于 4月22日。
L.Y.Z.
